remarks: View spectacular sunsets from this first floor 2 bedroom, 2 full bath Bayberry Landing condo.  Bayberry is a peaceful 24 unit complex with 400 feet of lake front.  Boat dock space dependent on availability.  Over 1,000 sq. feet of no steps for easy mobility.  In unit laundry/storage room has a newer washer/dryer combo.  Sliding glass doors open to 2 decks (one covered) to enjoy beautiful views of the lake and sunsets.  The living room electric fireplace offers a cozy ambience for chilly evenings.  Perfect get-away as a seasonal or year round residence.  Located between Mayville and Bemus Point, you are only a short drive to Lake Erie, Long Point State Park, Chautauqua Institution, and skiing at Peak and Peak.  Bayberry offers a tennis court and lakeside picnic tables as well.  Recent updates include:  luxury plank vinyl flooring, raised toilets, 55 gallon hot water tank, refrigerator, fireplace, kitchen sink, deck shade, lighting fixtures, deck railing and privacy fence.  This unit has an A/C combo heat wall unit.  Interior painted in 2018.  Public water is anticipated to connect to Bayberry Landing by end of 2026.  Seller is offering to sell furnished.  Kitchen has a breakfast bar with adjacent dining area.  This private retreat is one of the few units with no steps and close to the parking lot for easy living.  Don't Delay!  This is priced to sell!
